subject.title: [Feature]: Include interaction metadata in Discord button callbacks

question: Should generic Discord component callbacks expose a new agent-visible structured interaction metadata envelope, and which fields are safe to expose?
rationale: The request changes public agent inbound context and exposes Discord user identifiers plus callback data, so maintainers must choose the schema, compatibility shape, and trust boundary before implementation.

options.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
options.body: Expose a documented envelope with action kind, originating message id, safe callback/custom data, selected values or label, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

options.title: Keep Metadata Plugin-Only
options.body: Leave rich interaction fields on plugin interactive handlers and document that stateful Discord workflows should use plugin callbacks instead of generic agent fallback messages.

options.title: Expose Minimal Identity First
options.body: Start with clicker and originating message ids only, deferring callback payload semantics until a broader inbound metadata contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
recommendation.body: Expose a documented envelope with action kind, originating message id, safe callback/custom data, selected values or label, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision most closely matches the typed presentation action and cross-channel interaction contract work in this area.
